description: 4-beat video structure: hook → value → UGC → CTA. Each beat has script + action + camera. Visual + Audio sync.

defaults.style: TikTok-style UGC, talking head + product demo

beat_1_hook.name: hook
beat_1_hook.action_default: model looks at camera with concerned expression, holds product up to frame
beat_1_hook.camera_default: close-up on face + product, slight handheld shake

beat_2_value.name: value
beat_2_value.action_default: model shows product texture/scent, gestures to camera

beat_3_ugc.name: ugc
beat_3_ugc.action_default: model applies product to face, demonstrates texture on skin

beat_4_cta.name: cta
beat_4_cta.action_default: model points at camera, smiles, points down to where link will be
